[[File:SithOLantern-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|A Sith O' lantern]]
A '''Sith O' Lantern''' was a type of carved food that could be purchased from [[Z'ozpheratu]] during the [[Galactic Moon Festival]]. The participating city's of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] decorated their streets with a wide variety of these Sith O' Lanterns. The interiors of these Sith O' Lanterns were illuminated, possibly with the use of candles, to make the carved image appear to glow. Many Sith O' Lanterns were carved to depict a scary face, [[Cat/Legends|cat]], [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] text, or other images.

During the festival of [[Halloween/Legends|Halloween]], revelers would carve [[Pumpkin/Legends|pumpkins]] in a strikingly similar fashion to that of Sith O' Lanterns. However, it is not clear if Sith O' Lanterns were also pumpkins.
